```{=html}
<p>I am a social science methodologist and statistician working at the intersection of survey research, computational social science, and artificial intelligence. I earned my Ph.D. in Survey and Data Science from the University of Michigan in 2026.</p>
<p>My research asks how we can collect informative social data with limited resources. I develop methods for identifying groups that need different recruitment approaches, understanding who participates in surveys, and using AI to support data collection decisions. My collaborative work also examines health behavior, attitudes toward surveys, and public understanding of polls.</p>
<p>Alongside my research, I contribute to open-source software. As a research engineer at Utrecht University, I developed interfaces and supporting infrastructure for ASReview LAB, which uses active learning to assist systematic reviewing. I continued contributing as a volunteer maintainer after that appointment.</p>
```
